title: XForge Semantic Enrichment
description: Schema for .xforge/state/semantic-enrichment.json — the LLM-written feature sections (user flows, business rules, error handling, edge cases) merged by `xforge docs semantic --apply`. Every documented claim carries source refs; the CLI rejects entries citing files the project model does not contain.

features.description: Feature id -> its four semantic sections.

status.description: documented requires non-empty text and at least one source ref; the CLI validates both before merging.

text.description: Markdown content rendered into the feature document.

sources.description: Evidence for the claim. A documented section with no sources is rejected.

note.description: Why nothing is documented here (not_applicable / unknown).

file.description: Repo-relative path that must exist in the project model's source_files.
